content: Next standalone Docker with better-sqlite3: official with-docker Dockerfile (fetched verbatim) uses ARG NODE_VERSION=24.13.0-slim in 3 stages (dependencies/builder/runner), npm ci, npm run build, copies .next/standalone + .next/static, USER node, EXPOSE 3000, CMD node server.js, no build tools. Native module gotchas: standalone tracing can miss the .node binding; fix by copying node_modules/better-sqlite3/build into runner or npm rebuild in runner; install python3 make g++ in deps stage for source builds; same Node major in all stages to avoid NODE_MODULE_VERSION mismatch; better-sqlite3 issue #146 Could not locate bindings file.
